description: This file defines a set of simple methods related to General Ledger services in an OFBiz accounting module. The methods include creating accounting transactions, calculating trial balances, posting journals, handling account balances, and closing financial periods. It appears to be a configuration or script-like source file for procedural logic rather than pure code.

methods.name: quickCreateAcctgTransAndEntries
methods.description: Creates an accounting transaction with debit and credit entries.

methods.name: calculateGlJournalTrialBalance
methods.description: Calculates the trial balance for a journal, summing debits and credits from unposted transactions.

methods.name: postGlJournal
methods.description: Posts all unposted transactions in a journal after verifying the trial balance.

methods.name: updateGlReconciliationLastModified
methods.description: Updates the last modified info for a GlReconciliation record.

methods.name: createGlReconciliationEntry
methods.description: Adds an entry to a GlReconciliation, marking the associated transaction as reconciled.

methods.name: completeAcctgTransEntries
methods.description: Completes accounting transaction entries, setting the glAccountId if missing and creating the transaction.

methods.name: getGlAccountFromAccountType
methods.description: Resolves a GlAccountId from various parameters, including account type, party, payment, or product.

methods.name: getInventoryItemOwner
methods.description: Retrieves ownerPartyId from inventoryItemId, falling back to facility owner if necessary.

methods.name: closeFinancialTimePeriod
methods.description: Closes a financial time period, updating balances and creating history records.

methods.name: computeGlAccountBalanceForTimePeriod
methods.description: Calculates total debits, credits, opening, and ending balances of an account within a specified period.

methods.name: computeAndStoreGlAccountHistoryBalance
methods.description: Computes and stores balances for a GlAccountHistory record.

methods.name: prepareIncomeStatement
methods.description: Prepares data necessary for generating an income statement by summing relevant transactions.

methods.name: createAcctgTransAndEntries
methods.description: Creates accounting transactions with debit and credit entries, handling various event types by inserting detailed accounting records.

methods.name: createAcctgTransForSalesShipmentIssuance
methods.description: Creates accounting transactions for sales shipment issuance, handling inventory and COGS accounts, including inventory detail adjustments.

methods.name: createAcctgTransForCanceledSalesShipmentIssuance
methods.description: Handles accounting entries for canceled sales shipments, reversing inventory and COGS effects.

methods.name: createAcctgTransForInventoryItemCostChange
methods.description: Creates accounting entries when an inventory item’s cost is changed, considering FIFO/LIFO methods.

methods.name: createAcctgTransForPhysicalInventoryVariance
methods.description: Records physical inventory adjustments including variance entries impacting inventory accounts.

methods.name: createAcctgTransForWorkEffortInventoryProduced
methods.description: Posts GL entries for inventory produced during work efforts, involving WIP and inventory accounts.

methods.name: createAcctgTransForWorkEffortCost

methods.name: createAcctgTransForInventoryItemOwnerChange

methods.name: createAcctgTransForWorkEffortIssuance
methods.description: Posts HL for inventory issued to a work effort, affecting WIP and raw material inventories.

methods.name: createAcctgTransForFixedAssetMaintIssuance
methods.description: Creates GL entries for inventory issued for fixed asset maintenance, impacting inventory and fixed asset accounts.

methods.name: createAcctgTransAndEntriesForIncomingPayment
methods.description: Generates accounting transaction entries for incoming payments, including adjustments for payment applications.

methods.name: createAcctgTransForCustomerReturnInvoice
methods.description: Creates GL entries for customer return invoices, handling debit and credit entries for invoice items and taxes.

methods.name: createAcctgTransForWorkEffortIssuance
methods.description: Posts GL for inventory issued to a work effort, affecting WIP and raw material inventories.

methods.name: copyAcctgTransAndEntries
methods.description: Service to clone an existing accounting transaction and its entries, optionally reversing debit/credit flags.

methods.name: createAcctgTransAndEntriesForCustomerRefundPaymentApplication
methods.description: Service to create accounting entries for customer refund payment applications, avoiding duplicates for unpaid payments.

methods.name: createAcctgTransAndEntriesForPaymentApplication
methods.description: Service to create accounting entries for payment applications, handling different payment types and exchange rates.

methods.name: createAcctgTransForSalesInvoice
methods.description: Create GL transactions for a sales invoice, including tax and total amount handling.

methods.name: createAcctgTransAndEntriesForOutgoingPayment
methods.description: Create accounting transactions and entries for outgoing payments, including disbursements and payment applications.
